bio.text: The Florida Senate website lists Joe Gruters as the District 22 senator for 2024-2026; Gruters was first elected to the Senate in 2018, after serving in the Florida House of Representatives from 2016 to 2018.

According to the Florida Phoenix, Gruters was elected chair of the Republican National Committee on August 22, 2025, and said then that he planned to remain in the Florida Senate while heading the RNC.
Gruters is a certified public accountant who was born in Tampa and chaired the Sarasota County Planning Commission.
Gruters holds a B.S. from Florida State University (1999) and an MBA from the University of South Florida (2003).
